propositions: Recursive tests/**/conftest.py global-support pattern causes all seven mutation shards to trigger for any nested conftest change, regardless of actual fixture dependencies
Runtime tracing confirms pytest loads only six ancestor conftests per shard, not sibling fixture trees like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py
Over-triggers across 97 recent Verify runs consumed 5.38 runner-hours of Ubuntu runner time without increasing test coverage
Dependency-accurate conftest-to-shard mapping matches pytest's upward-only conftest discovery and aligns with Jest and Nx affected-test selection patterns
A derived ancestry-equality contract ensures per-shard support lists exactly match the ancestor conftests loaded by configured test paths, failing closed on missing or stale entries
Unrelated nested conftest changes now select no shards; each ancestor conftest change selects only its dependent shards
